verdict.rationale: Copilot documents Automations that run the cloud agent on a schedule or on repository events, plus audit logs for tracking agent activity and a workspace for reviewing agent changes before merging. Nothing states that the automation definitions themselves are version-controlled, reviewable, or can be rolled back, so support is thin and largely implied. Missing for 10: documented versioning of automation definitions, a review/approval flow for changes to automations, rollback to prior automation versions, and hands-on corroboration.
